purpose: Bounded native Codex delegation with disjoint simultaneous writers and a separate read-only verifier
scope: one task D01, local outputs only
outcome: artifacts/D01-A.txt contains D01-A plus newline; artifacts/D01-B.txt contains D01-B plus newline; append D01 once to execution.txt only after both outputs and independent evaluation pass
verifierOwnership: read-only; different agent from either writer
acceptance: Each assignment names result, parent, allowed file, necessary sources and verification; no subdelegation or external work
Workers return exactly once to the parent without modifying control state, peer file, tools, installed skills or user files
Both outputs contain exact expected literal bytes
A different agent reviews actual current outputs and preservation before parent marks done
Parent integrates by validating both outputs, appending once and recording actual verification; no merge/publication claim
limits: One synthetic exercise; no proof of general delegation quality or real-project parallel integration
